reports.text: This road is in fairly good shape with a few exceptions.
Other then that it is smooth riding.
This is a very tight and twisty road.
Winding your way right and left for mile after mile you get your fill of turns and scenery.
Breath taking views of snow capped Sierra Mountains will be in the background as you dive into this canyon.
